name: ravel
description: Visually group Git commits and send a precise squash instruction to Codex.

interface.shortDescription: A cleaner Git history, one click at a time.
interface.longDescription: Open a repository's commit chain inside Codex. Squash adjacent older commits into newer targets, preview the instruction, and confirm to send it to your current task.
defaultPrompt: Use $ravel to open this repository's commit chain.
